description: This file defines a utility class for managing IARM bus connections within the Utils namespace. It includes functions to initialize the connection, check if connected, and uses macros for error checking and logging.

classes.name: Utils::IARM
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to initialize and check the status of the IARM bus connection.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the IARM bus connection, attempting retries if necessary.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IARM bus is currently connected.
